items.finding: Initial new-table GPU foreign key used the logical class name instead of the existing gpu_resources table.
items.resolution: Transaction rolled back; corrected the ORM and migration target, then repeated backup/archive verification and both upgrades. Alembic check reports no model drift.

items.finding: Unit and integration test modules shared a basename under pytest prepend imports.
items.resolution: Renamed the integration module before rerunning. No production behavior changed.

items.finding: Eight failures in the first 171-case run: two fixtures requested an unauthorized quality, two expected 412 instead of the established 409 conflict, four compared SQLite integer acknowledgement flags by boolean identity.
items.resolution: Used an authorized distinct size, matched the frozen conflict behavior, normalized acknowledgement assertions. Added further independent-GPU/release and failure/resume concurrency coverage; final targeted run 185 passed.

items.finding: A checked launcher could exit with its child between process lookup and Stop-Process.
items.resolution: The stop script only tolerates the race when that PID no longer exists; identity and still-running errors remain visible. Registered API/Runner/GC were restarted and reverified.

items.finding: The default Playwright browser executable was unavailable; Element Plus label/combobox/hidden-option selection and an open drawer required more precise interactions.
items.resolution: Used the existing native Edge channel, keyboard interaction for the select, explicit drawer close, and table-scoped alert assertion. Screenshot confirmed the alert had rendered correctly. Final 10 new and 22 regression groups passed; every created context/browser closed in finally.
